topic: The child actor who sued the studio for stealing their entire childhood salary
hook: She earned millions as a child. The studio took all of it.
script: She earned millions as a child. The studio took all of it. Jackie Coogan earned an estimated 4 million dollars as a child star in the 1920s. By the time he turned 18 and asked for his money, his mother and stepfather had spent virtually all of it. California had no laws protecting child actor earnings. Coogan sued his own mother. He won almost nothing. California passed the Coogan Law in 1939 to protect future child actors. Follow for Hollywood injustices that changed the law.
